bounded_hypotheses.claim: Incomplete ChartStore settings may later cause visible candle, indicator, or interaction corruption.
bounded_hypotheses.falsifier: Repeated interaction, symbol/timeframe transition, history-backfill, and reload tests show no visible divergence while the validation errors remain.

confirmed_findings.claim: The published BTC/USDT indicator chart initializes with missing required ChartStore settings on first load and repeats the same validation failure after reload.
confirmed_findings.regression_relation: The January 2026 manual audit reported the same initialization-contract family with different missing ChartStore and IndicatorManager fields.

confirmed_findings.claim: During three independent 90–120 second browser-level network outages, the public BTC/USDT chart and price remained visibly plausible without an offline, stale, delayed, disconnected, or reconnecting state; zero quote responses arrived during each outage and a new non-empty quote response arrived after every restore.
limitations: The visible price was not compared with an external market source.
The evidence does not establish authenticated workspace behavior or trading-decision impact.
The evidence does not establish visible application rollback from an older response.

passed_checks.claim: The public page loaded BTC/USDT metadata, historical bars, and changing quote payloads.
All three browser-level outages exceeded the configured 90, 105, and 120 second thresholds and received zero quote responses while offline.
A new non-empty quote response arrived and the visible chart remained available after networking was restored in all three rounds.
The BTC chart reconstructed after reload, although ChartStore validation errors repeated.

recommended_human_actions: Report the repeated ChartStore required-field initialization failure as a bounded P2 regression.
Report the missing public freshness boundary during prolonged network outage as a separate bounded P2 user-control defect.
Add an explicit stale, offline, delayed, or reconnecting state tied to quote age and transport recovery.
Do not claim that the retained visible price was numerically inaccurate without an external market comparison.
Keep authenticated workspace, alerts, orders, application rollback, and trading-decision impact outside this public audit.

subject.scope: public unauthenticated published-indicator chart, quote freshness, outage, and recovery behavior

unknowns: The retained visible price was not compared with an external market source, so numerical inaccuracy is not claimed.
The authenticated workspace may use a different quote transport, freshness threshold, and recovery policy.
Historical backfill, candle/indicator layer integrity, and duplicate or missing bars were not established.
Symbol and timeframe transition atomicity were not tested on an authorized interactive workspace.
Visible application rollback after older-response delivery remains unverified.
No user-visible trading-decision impact was established for either confirmed public finding.
verdict_meaning: Present the two confirmed bounded P2 findings and remaining uncertainty to an authorized human owner; do not claim numerical price inaccuracy, submit externally, execute, or merge automatically.
